summary: InPoint Commercial Real Estate Income, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to announce a routine board-authorized distribution to stockholders of record as of August 31, 2026. Gross distribution is $0.1042 per share across Classes A, D, I, P, and T, with stockholder servicing fees reducing net amounts for Classes D ($0.1014) and T ($0.0946). No special situation, strategic action, or transaction is involved. The filing is a routine current report regarding ordinary dividend payments.
